name: Genspark
tagline: AI super-agent that researches, builds, and acts
description: Genspark is an AI 'super agent' workspace combining deep research, document generation, web automation, and outbound phone calls into a single interface. Backed by a $275M Series B at $1.25B valuation in November 2025, the Super Agent product (April 2025) competes directly with Manus and OpenAI Operator.
